ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH RAI K  ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused in C.C.No.19023/2022, arising out of Crime No.158/2021, registered by Rural Police Station, Kalaburagi, for the offences punishable under Sections 273 and 336 of IPC, 1860 and Section 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, pending on the file of V-Additional Civil Judge and JMFC, Kalaburagi.

2. The abridged facts of the case are, the complainant, being the Food and Quality Control Officer at Kalaburagi, lodged a complaint before respondent-Police on 08.08.2021 alleging that on 05.08.2021, he received credible information regarding production of illegal tobacco NC:
2026:KHC-K:1744 HC-KAR in the name of 'GOA 1000' within the jurisdiction of respondent-Police.
As such, the complainant along with the panchas and staff visited the said spot on the same day.
However, on inspection they did not find any evidence of production of tobacco in the alleged scene of incident.
Later, a panchanama was drawn by the complainant and accordingly, a complaint was filed before the respondent-Police, which was registered in Crime No.158/2021.

3. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned High Court Government Pleader for the respondent-State.
4.
It is contended by learned counsel for the petitioner that, since no machine or any kind of material was seized from the alleged scene of incident, no case is made against the petitioner.
As such, he prays to allow the petition.
NC: 2026:KHC-K:1744 HC-KAR 5.

Per contra, learned High Court Government Pleader opposed the prayer and submitted that now the case is set for trial before the learned Magistrate and CW.1 has already appeared before the Court, as such, the case cannot be quashed at this stage.
Hence, he prays to dismiss the petition.
6. I have given my anxious consideration both on the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties and the documents made available on record.

sentences.text: On perusal of the proceedings of the Trial Court, the present case is posted for evidence before the Trial Court and on 12.01.2026, CW.1 was present before the Court and prayed time for deposing evidence.
Thereafter, this petition has been filed.

In such circumstance, the proceedings cannot be quashed at this belated stage; instead, the learned Magistrate is directed to conclude the trial at the earliest, preferably, within an NC: 2026:KHC-K:1744 HC-KAR outer limit of three months.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed off.
